source: Bybit V5 public market API + public WebSocket / linear perpetual

notes.daily_buckets: Native UTC 1D candles from Bybit REST.
notes.trade_flow: PublicTrade Buy turnover minus Sell turnover.
notes.cvd: Cumulative from start of available range, not absolute exchange CVD.
notes.liquidations: Bybit allLiquidation; S=Buy long liquidation; S=Sell short liquidation.
notes.flow_history: WebSocket-only. Coverage is observation-based; CVD segmented, partial buckets excluded.

trade_flow.meaning: OBSERVED_CONTINUOUS means local WS session spans a full bucket; it does not prove lossless exchange delivery.

liquidations.meaning: OBSERVED_CONTINUOUS means local WS session spans a full bucket; it does not prove lossless exchange delivery.

flow_coverage.note: WS observation starts when collector connects. No events != verified zero. Delta of PARTIAL buckets is incomplete. CVD excludes partial/unknown buckets and resets after gaps.
